title: Campaign upload
lede: One workbook for one deal. HQ reads it all or none: a file with no error waits for an approver as one campaign upload, and goes live as one version.
denied: You do not have access to this action.

template.title: Get a workbook
template.hint: Start from the blank template, or convert the SAP BBy file of a deal into one. The template's Upload, Campaigns and Items sheets carry dropdowns for Stacking, Mechanic, Kind, Members, List and Type.
template.failed: The template could not be downloaded. Try again.

convert.next: Next: open it and review it — the proposed DealCode, the names, and every PRICE value. Read its Convert notes sheet if it has one, then upload it below.
convert.stored: The conversion stored nothing, and its notes are only in the workbook.
convert.failed: The file could not be converted. Try again.

upload.title: Upload the workbook
upload.hint: The whole deal in one file. The Note on its Upload sheet is what the approver reads.
upload.failed: The file could not be read. Try again.

outcome.refused_one: Nothing was stored: the file has <n>{{count}}</n> error. Fix every one and upload the whole file again.
outcome.refused_other: Nothing was stored: the file has <n>{{count}}</n> errors. Fix every one and upload the whole file again.
outcome.waiting: Waiting for approval — deal <deal>{{deal}}</deal>, revision <rev>{{revision}}</rev>. An approver activates it as one version.
outcome.unstored: The file was read, but HQ stored nothing.

json.none: HQ sent no JSON for this campaign.
